name: AIclicks
description:
AIclicks MCP brings your AI-search brand-visibility data into Claude. It connects to your aiclicks account and exposes the same analytics the aiclicks dashboard runs on, so you can ask Claude how your brand shows up across AI assistants and get answers backed by live data.
▎
Requires an aiclicks account (aiclicks.io) — the server reads from and writes to your aiclicks workspace and does nothing without it.

What you can do:
• Visibility & mentions — daily visibility share, mention/citation trends, citability, and a per-model leaderboard (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews, Claude…).
• Citations — URL-level citations your brand earns in AI answers, plus the prompts that triggered them.
• Competitors — rankings and share-of-voice vs tracked rivals, trends over time, and discovery of rivals you aren't tracking yet.
• Sentiment — positive/negative split, trends, themes, and the sources shaping how AI talks about your brand.
• Prompts & fanout — the queries aiclicks tracks and the expanded fanout variants behind them.
 • ChatGPT ads — advertisers, KPIs, leaderboards, timelines, and ad cards seen on your prompts.
• GA4 attribution — real site traffic referred by AI assistants: sessions, top pages, locations, devices, and conversions.
• Manage — create a domain (brand), add prompts, add competitors.

Works across one or many brands. Read tools run freely; write tools (create domain, add prompt, add competitor) always confirm first and need a Pro+ aiclicks plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AIclicks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AIclicks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aiclicks.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AIclicks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIclicks lists 37 MCP tools, including add_competitor, add_prompt, create_domain, get_brand_rankings, get_chatgpt_ads_cards, get_chatgpt_ads_kpis, get_chatgpt_ads_leaderboard, get_chatgpt_ads_prompts, get_chatgpt_ads_timeline, get_citability_time_series, get_citations, and get_citations_time_series.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AIclicks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AIclicks in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AIclicks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AIclicks is developed by AIclicks. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
